column2: Enter does not accept a slash ghost
Right commits without inserting a child
Right previews child then Tab accepts
partial child resolves lazily on Tab
Tab keeps rotating a child subset
slash phrase requires committing its parent
slash scope is buffer start only
start-only phrase does not activate in middle
deleting after activation exit edits literal text
leaving an unmatched activation preserves its trigger
normal Right within token does not accept ghost
nonbreaking space is not a word boundary
new word trigger takes over unmatched phrase
moving after committed leaf preserves draft
reused phrase suffix is restored when cycling
editing an accepted filename to an unknown token
space inside an exact candidate leaves an unmatched prefix
